facts.text: The live skating page checked November 14, 2026 lists Wooster Pike’s opening date as November 15 and closing date as January 2, with opening and all skating availability dependent on weather. The dates do not confirm that the rink is operating before a visit.
quote: Wooster Pike Ice Skating Hours & Information Opening date November 15th Depending on Mother Nature! Closing date January 2nd
All skating hours and availability are weather dependent.

facts.text: Wooster Pike’s posted public skating hours are Monday–Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–9 p.m., with ice-maintenance breaks from 2–3 p.m. and 6–7 p.m. Public skating is first come, first served without online reservations; private rink rentals can still be booked ahead. Availability depends on weather.
quote: Wooster Pike Ice Skating Hours & Information
Public Skating Hours Monday–Saturday 11:00 AM–10:00 PM Ice maintenance breaks: 2:00–3:00 PM | 6:00–7:00 PM Sunday 11:00 AM–9:00 PM Ice maintenance breaks: 2:00–3:00 PM | 6:00–7:00 PM
Ice skating will be available on a first-come, first-served basis.
Online reservations will no longer be available for public skating, but private rink rentals can still be booked in advance.
All skating hours and availability are weather dependent.

facts.text: The shared skating instructions direct visitors to the League Station, or to ask a team member for directions, then sign a waiver, pay and collect skates. Admission is $10 for skate rental and one hour of ice time; children aged four or younger skate free. The instructions do not establish a step-free rink entrance, transfer help or adaptive-skating arrangements.
quote: When you arrive, head over to our League Station or ask any Fifty West team member, and we’ll point you in the right direction!
From there, you’ll sign a quick waiver, pay for your session, grab your skates, and you’re ready to hit the ice!
Admission includes skate rental and one hour of ice time
